summary.name: MacsyZones
summary.one_liner: MacsyZones is a macOS window management tool that lets you define custom snap zones and layouts, described as a FancyZones equivalent for macOS.
use_cases: snap windows into custom zones on macOS
design layouts for multiple monitors and virtual desktops
resize windows to aligned edges between zones
summary.what_it_does: MacsyZones lets you create layouts of zones on your screen and snap windows into them by holding a Snap Key while dragging, or by right-click snapping. It includes Shake to Snap, where shaking the mouse while dragging a window brings up zones, and Snap Resize, which adds resizers between zones so window edges can align precisely. Quick Snapper is a keyboard mode for navigating zones and layouts with arrow keys and number keys. Grid Layouts overlays an adjustable grid so you can draw the snap area. It remembers the preferred layout for each screen and workspace combination.
notable: Open source, with a free download and a paid 'Pro' version that is functionally the same and only differs in name
Shake to Snap and Snap Resize for trackpad-friendly and precise alignment
Quick Snapper keyboard-centric mode for zones, layouts and window switching
caveats: Requires macOS Accessibility permission to function
Layout Editor placing zones on another screen is undefined behavior per the page
Page describes the app as just released (latest version 3.1.1, dated 15 Sep 2026)
